a field of a `TypeMap`, `TypeAccumulator`, `VariantTraversal`, tree map/accumulator/traverser, `TypeComparer` or `ConstraintHandling`: one traversal's or one reader's scratch (comparers are per reader, `Reader.comparers`; §8 I91 `TypeMap.variance`)

`myFlags`, `myInfo`, `myAnnotations`, `myParamss`, `myPrivateWithin`, `myCompanion`, `myDecls`, `mySourceModule`, `myModuleClass` of a `SymDenotation`: the denotation's own state, written by its completion (§8 I91 'not caches')
`myValidFor`, `nextInRun` of a denotation: written by `Denotation.current` on the first read in a run (§3 B)
a field of an `Iterator`: one traversal's
a field of a `SymDenotations.LazyType` (completers, symbol loaders, TASTy and Scala 2 completers)
a field of an `InheritedCache` implementation (base data, member names: a second black hole, §3.1)
a field of `LazyRef` or of a lazy annotation (`Annotations.LazyAnnotation`, `LazyBodyAnnotation` and their subclasses)
a field of a class in `core.tasty`, `core.classfile` or `core.unpickleScala2`: lazy TASTy/classfile reads (`symAtAddr`, `treeAtAddr`)
a field of `Scopes.MutableScope`: completions enter into shared scopes that rehash on `enter`
read or written in a stamp, value or setter argument of a `core.Caching` helper (the lint of `StampedCachesTest`)
a stamp: declared `Period`, `RunId` or `Validity`, or named `…Period`, `…RunId`, `valid…`, `checked…` (`StampedCachesTest.stampFields`)
named by a `VarHandle` in `util/Publish.java`, or read or written in a method that calls `util.Publish` on the same object (the value the stamp publishes)
on a type, denotation or symbol, `@volatile` and declared a tuple or a non-value class with two or more fields, all `val`s: a multi-field cache packed into one immutable value
`myDesignator` of a `NamedType`: part of the interned key, rewritten by `setDenot` (§3 D)
any other field of a `Type` other than a `TypeVar`: types are hash-consed values, so a field on one memoises a function of the type
a `private var myX: T | Null = null` (not a collection) read and written in one method: a lazily initialised value (the pattern §8's I91 audit enumerates)
named `…cache…`/`…Cache…`, `cached…`, `last[A-Z]…`, `my…Hash`
a field of `util.WeakHashSet`, `util.ConcurrentWeakHashSet` or a class in `core/Uniques.scala`, or declared `Uniques`
a field of a class in `core/Names.scala` (the name table)
named `_next…Id`, `next…Id`, `nextId`, `…SymId(s)`, or a field of a `FreshNameCreator`
a field of `ast.Trees.Tree`, `ast.Positioned`, `util.Attachment.Container` or `Attachment.Link` (`myTpe`, `span`, `myMods`, attachments)
a field of `InteractiveDriver.Session` (the session's typed tree and skipped statements)
`tpdTree`, `untpdTree` of `CompilationUnit`
declared `ThreadLocal`
kind A (`A.reader`, `A.traversal`): the owner is one reader's or one traversal's
reach `post-typer` (see `reach`): written in phases after typer, which the interactive compiler does not run (§8 I91 class 3)
named by a `VarHandle` in `util/Publish.java` (release store, acquire load)
`@volatile` and declared a tuple or a class whose fields are all `val`s
`@volatile`, a single value
declared a `java.util.concurrent` or `scala.collection.concurrent` type, an atomic, `util.ConcurrentWeakHashSet` or `util.SyncEqHashMap`
initialised by `Sharing.newMap`, `newEqHashMap` or `new…Uniques`: a concurrent structure when the base is concurrent

kind `B.denotation`, `B.completer` or `B.unpickler`: written while the completion lock or the root's claim is held by `lockAndComplete`/`Sharing.exclusive` further up the stack (dynamic, not visible at the access; evidence `asserted`)

every access outside initialisation (constructors, field initialisers) and resets (`= Nowhere`, `= NoRunId`), each classified innermost-first: in a `Caching` stamp/value/setter argument → Caching; in a `synchronized` block or `Sharing.serialised` → synchronized; in the `op` of `Sharing.exclusive`, `SharingImpl.exclusive` or `CompletionLock.locked` → completion-lock; in the `op` of `Sharing.claimed`, `SharingImpl.claimed` or `CompletionRoots.locked` → root-claim; in a method that calls `util.Publish` → Publish; in the else branch of `if .concurrent`, `if .parallel` or `if Config. && .concurrent` (or the then branch of the negation) → batch; else, in a private or local method, the one protection that every call of the method has (calls in a batch branch aside), recursively; else none. The field's protection: the one protection of all non-batch accesses; `batch-only` if every access is batch; `partial:

` if some are P and some none; `mixed:` for two protections; `unknown` if no access is seen

the owner is in `cc`, `backend` or `transform` (other than `SetRootTree`, `CookComments`), or is a `Phase` other than the interactive compiler's (`Parser`, `TyperPhase`, `SetRootTree`, `CookComments`, `InteractiveCompiler.phases`)
everything else: reachable from the interactive compiler's typer

the internals of a mutable collection class (`util.MutableMap`, `MutableSet`, `GenericHashMap`, `GenericHashSet`, `MutableIdentitySet`, `IntMap`, `PerfectHashing`, `SimpleIdentityMap`, `SimpleIdentitySet`): modelled where the collection is held
synthetic fields (`$values` of enums) and `lazy val`s (not modelled yet)

features.doc: a class named `MatchType…`, `MatchCase…`, `MatchReducer…`, or a field named `…reduce…`/`…Reduced…`

header.note: Rules are tried in order; the first that matches sets kind and protection. `evidence` says what the protection rests on: lexical (the accesses), annotation, type, owner, or asserted (dynamic, from §8, not visible at the access).
